{
  "meta": {
    "title": "Why a Slow Rate-Limiter Store Sent 40x Traffic",
    "topicClass": "concept",
    "format": "full",
    "targetLengthSec": 84
  },
  "story": {
    "devices": [
      "contention_hook",
      "failure_before_fix",
      "object_to_data",
      "what_breaks",
      "counterfactual",
      "real_incident",
      "contrast_takeaway",
      "spec_card_ending"
    ],
    "runningExample": "One client with key 7781 sends a 100-request burst to the /search route through the Hollowmere gateway.",
    "chapters": [
      {
        "id": "ch1",
        "title": "What can go wrong"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch2",
        "title": "The token bucket"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch3",
        "title": "The slow-store incident"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch4",
        "title": "After the fix"
      }
    ],
    "beats": [
      {
        "id": "b1",
        "chapterId": "ch1",
        "intent": "Viewer sees 40 checkout instances each enforcing the full limit while local fallback is on, so the downstream payment provider receives roughly 40 times the contracted rate and starts throttling.",
        "device": "contention_hook",
        "targetSec": 8,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-19",
          "fact-21"
        ],
        "hookNumberIds": [
          "num-24",
          "num-23"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "pipeline",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": []
      },
      {
        "id": "b2",
        "chapterId": "ch1",
        "intent": "Viewer sees the naive fixed-window counter reset at the minute boundary, allowing a client to spend the full quota twice inside two seconds.",
        "device": "failure_before_fix",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-9",
          "num-6"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "versus_split",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "versus_split"
        ],
        "newTerms": []
      },
      {
        "id": "b3",
        "chapterId": "ch2",
        "intent": "Viewer sees the free-tier bucket start with 100 tokens, drain by 100 requests, then refill at 10 tokens per second, so a burst stays bounded.",
        "device": "object_to_data",
        "targetSec": 12,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-1",
          "fact-2",
          "fact-5",
          "num-1",
          "num-2"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "centered_focus",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": [
          "token bucket"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "b4",
        "chapterId": "ch2",
        "intent": "Viewer sees two gateway nodes read the same last token and both admit a request when the check is not one indivisible step, so the bucket can overshoot.",
        "device": "what_breaks",
        "targetSec": 12,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-6"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "hub_spoke",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "atomic_lock"
        ],
        "newTerms": [
          "atomic script"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "b5",
        "chapterId": "ch2",
        "intent": "Viewer sees that giving each of 24 gateway nodes its own bucket would multiply one client's limit by 24, so the bucket must live in one shared store.",
        "device": "counterfactual",
        "targetSec": 8,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-7",
          "num-3"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": true,
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": []
      },
      {
        "id": "b6",
        "chapterId": "ch3",
        "intent": "Viewer sees a routine failover push the shared store to another zone, store latency rise from 1 ms to 80 ms, the 50 ms timeout mark calls as failures, and fail-open local limits amplify traffic to 40 times the contract.",
        "device": "real_incident",
        "targetSec": 14,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-19",
          "fact-20",
          "fact-21",
          "fact-22",
          "num-18",
          "num-19",
          "num-22",
          "num-23"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "swimlane",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": [],
        "source": "Larkspur Pay platform team, 14 March 2025"
      },
      {
        "id": "b7",
        "chapterId": "ch3",
        "intent": "Viewer sees the chosen fix on the payment-provider route: fail closed, local fallback limits divided across 40 instances, and the store timeout raised to 150 ms.",
        "device": "contrast_takeaway",
        "targetSec": 12,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-23",
          "num-25"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "two_column",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": [
          "fail closed"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "b8",
        "chapterId": "ch4",
        "intent": "Viewer sees the final three-line design card summarise the token bucket, the shared atomic store, and the fail-closed edge.",
        "device": "spec_card_ending",
        "targetSec": 8,
        "factIds": [],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "centered_focus",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": []
      }
    ],
    "plantedQuestion": {
      "text": "How does one slow store turn a 300 rps limit into 40 times that?",
      "beatId": "b1",
      "payoffBeatId": "b6"
    },
    "rejectedAlternative": {
      "beatId": "b2",
      "summary": "Counting per calendar minute resets the counter at the boundary; a client can spend the whole quota in the last second of one minute and again in the first second of the next.",
      "chosenBeatId": "b3"
    },
    "ending": {
      "kind": "spec_card_ending",
      "cta": "Share this with an engineer who owns a public API.",
      "specCard": {
        "lines": [
          "Token bucket: capacity + refill",
          "One shared store runs one atomic script",
          "Fail closed at downstream contracts"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
